component.name: PianoForge
component.summary: PianoForge's sound, keyboard and text sources, read straight from the application

description.p: The PianoForge piano in OBS without a cable: its sound at the stream's own level, a keyboard that lights up as it plays, a text of what is played, and chapter markers in recordings. OBS must see the system's shared memory: flatpak override --user --device=shm com.obsproject.Studio.
